xmldoc.short_description: Keep only a time window of an ISHNE record.

param_input_item.param_description: the window in seconds, the second value greater than the first.
with 'Samples', true, the window as sample indices (one based, inclusive) instead of seconds.

param_output_item.param_description: the struct cut to the window.

description.p: Keeps only the window of the struct from ishne.read. All leads of an ISHNE file share one rate, so the cut falls on the same instant on every lead.
With 'Samples', true the window is read as sample indices rather than seconds.
